BiblicalUsage: Ganan means to hedge about, to guard and defend — and it is God's own promise to Jerusalem. The LORD says He will defend this city in 2 Kings 19:34, for His own sake and for His servant David's sake, and the same promise stands in 2 Kings 20:6, when He adds fifteen years to Hezekiah's days. Isaiah pictures Him as birds flying over the nest in Isaiah 31:5, defending and delivering, and Zechariah says the LORD shall defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem in Zechariah 12:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hedge around Jerusalem is the hedge around every believer. God defends His city for His own sake and for David's, and I hold that He defends us the same way — not because we are strong, but because we are His.
